product_metadata.title: Vornado Pivot Heat Electric Space Heater with 20-Degrees of Tilt, Adjustable Thermostat, Advanced Safety Features, for Home and Office, White
features: HEAT DIFFERENTLY — Gently heat all in the air in a small to medium-sized room through vortex air circulation without using intense heat, similar to how a forced air furnace works, just on a smaller scale.
HEAT SAFELY — ETL certified and equipped with advanced safety features, including a cool-touch exterior, tip-over protection, and 2-stage automatic safety shut-off for worry-free use.
HEAT EFFICIENTLY — Toggle between the 2 heat settings (Low/750W, High/1500W) to tailor heat output and energy consumption.
CONTROL YOUR COMFORT — Dial in your desired room temperature by using the adjustable thermostat and the heater will automatically turn on and off to maintain desired comfort level.
SUPERIOR SUPPORT — Backed by a 5-year hassle-free and supported by a customer service team based in Andover, KS.
Built to meet U. S. voltage requirements. Certified, safety-tested, and warrantied for use only in the U. S.
description: With a modern chrome steel base, Pivot Heat is sure to make a visual statement in your home. The adjustable axis tilts 20 degrees for custom comfort. Combine that with Vornado’s powerful vortex circulation, it is sure to keep your room sultry and stylish no matter how low the temperature drops outside. This whole room heater is equipped with advanced safety features to provide worry-free use including a tip-over switch that automatically cuts the heat and power to the unit if tipped over. With Vornado’s unique design, Pivot Heat remains cool to the touch, even after hours of extended operation.

IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL DISCLAIMER: This item is built to meet U.S. voltage requirements and may not function properly when used in conjunction with external devices that alter or convert voltage or frequency of electricity. Improper use or shipping the product outside the U.S. will void all warranties.
